page_annotations: I reviewed the overview and all six native tiles: top, middle, bottom, outer margin, gutter and the spaces between ruled lines. Apart from the folio number, the page has no catalogue entries, headings, cross-references or marginal notes in ink or pencil.
The faint grey letterforms across the ruled lines are mirror-image show-through of the entries on the recto, fol. 256. They are not writing on this page and are not transcribed.

Several non-text marks are present. Dark triangular tab or mounting shadows sit at the top edge, near x 300–330 and x 770–860. A short faint diagonal stroke with a dot lies near x 1705–1795, y 675–715. Short faint pencil dashes appear in the left margin at about y 1460–1580, x 340–470; the inventory gave these at y 3060–3240, so the position should be checked. A grey abrasion smudge lies at about x 470–650, y 2620–2960. Binding thread and gutter shadow run along the inner edge. None of these marks is legible as text.

The right edge of the image shows part of the facing page, fol. 257. Its marginal notes are not target text and have not been recorded here: the circled 'main', 'c.104(3)', 'ff.2-15', the 'Begins ... Indriya...' note, and 'ff.1-71, ... R.L.M.'

coverage.finding: The pencil folio number in the top left corner is at about native [345,300,140,130]. It reads '256' with a raised final letter that is consistent with 'b'. Record r001 represents it correctly, and its note on the superscript and its uncertainty statement are appropriate. There is no other legible writing on the target page. The non-text marks are disposed of as follows, none being a record. The dark mounting or tab shadows at the top edge lie at about x 305–335 and x 770–860, y 270–370. The faint diagonal stroke with a dot lies at about [1709,675,85,40]. The two faint left-margin pencil dashes are confirmed in native tile 1 (offset 0,0) at about [345,1455,120,125], that is y ≈1460–1580; the candidate's position is right and the inventory's y 3060–3240 is wrong. The grey abrasion smudge lies at about [470,2640,170,400]. There is a white fibre or hair near [2590,3900,70,170]. The binding thread and gutter shadow run at about x 3190–3245. None of these marks is writing. The facing-page fragments of fol. 257 (x > 3250) are excluded as non-target. The mirrored show-through from fol. 256 is not ink on this page.

review.boundary_review: The target page runs from about x 300 to x ~3200, with the gutter and binding thread at about x 3190–3245. Everything to the right of about x 3250 belongs to the facing page, fol. 257, and is not target text. That material comprises the vertical bracket line, the circled 'main', 'c.104(3)', the arrowed and cancelled 'ff.2-15' notes, the 'Begins ... Indriya...' note and 'ff.1-71, ... R.L.M.'. The adjacent fol. 257 image confirms that these are its left-margin notes. The faint reversed letterforms across the ruled lines of the target page match the recto layout of fol. 256 and are show-through, not writing.
